{{Top}}
'''Scalefish''' were a variety of small fish native to the [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]], [[lake]]s, and [[Swamp/Legends|swamps]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], particularly around the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] city of [[Otoh Gunga/Legends|Otoh Gunga]].

It was believed the scalefish were attracted to the glowing lights of Otoh Gunga, though the scalefish learned through experience not to pass through the [[Hydrostatic bubble/Legends|hydrostatic bubble]] structures into the air-filled interior.<ref name="VD">''[[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>

Most scalefish were deemed harmless, although the [[Faa/Legends|faa]] was carnivorous,<ref name="TGF">[[Star Wars Episode I: The Gungan Frontier|''Star Wars'' Episode I: ''The Gungan Frontier'']]</ref> and the [[Mee/Legends|mee]] wielded a poisonous spine.<ref name="CSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

*[[Laa/Legends|Laa]]
*[[Mee/Legends|Mee]], or ''daggert''
*[[Ray/Legends|Ray]]
*[[See/Legends|See]]
*[[Tee/Legends|Tee]]

==Behind the scenes==
The types of scalefish are named for the notes of a [[Wikipedia:Scale (music)|musical scale]] as expressed in [[Wikipedia:Solfège|solfège]] (''do'', ''re'', ''mi'', ''fa'', ''sol'', ''la'', and ''ti''). There is a scalefish corresponding to each of these pitch names, though ''sol'' is replaced by ''si'', which in solfège is ''sol'' raised a [[Wikipedia:Semitone|half step]].
